worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.summary: A light butterfly dance: a few beats shed scales that hang around the user as a thin veil, raising Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed. The veil lasts for a visible window, after which the three stats it raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.use.0: Build Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed before a fight
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.use.1: Raise a scale veil first when pressed by special attacks
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.use.2: Spread scales while repositioning to make the ground around you your own
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.descriptio: After the wind-up Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed each rise by %1$s.
The veil lasts %1$s; dancing again while it stands raises each stat once more and renews the window, up to 6 levels each; when the window ends, the accumulated levels are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.veil.on: Thick veil: the veil window by 1.35, at the cost of a 2-tick longer wind-up and 12 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.veil.off: Light dusting: fewer scales and the regular window, but quicker to finish.
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.growth.0: At level %1$s the veil stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.growth.1: At level %1$s the veil stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.quiverdance.preference: On: the veil window by 1.35, at the cost of a 2-tick longer wind-up and 12 ticks more cooldown. Off: light dusting, quicker to finish.
The move is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means laying the veil earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of dancing; larger gives up the buff more often up close.
world_combat.move.quiverdance.text.bloom: Scale veil · Sp. Atk / Sp. Def / Speed +%1$s
